help.title: Help and FAQs
help.subtitle: Quick answers for finding, saving, and applying to government schemes.

info.question: What information do I need?
info.answer: Enter your category, state, business type, age, income, and a short description of your idea.

official.question: Are these schemes official?
official.answer: SchemeSetu helps you discover schemes. Always verify eligibility and apply through the official portal.

save.question: How do I save a scheme?
save.answer: Log in and press Save on any scheme card. Saved schemes appear under My bookmarks.

empty.question: Why are no schemes showing?
empty.answer: Try a broader description, check spelling, and review the income and age details.

language.question: Can I use Hindi or Telugu?
language.answer: Yes. Change the language from the landing page or Settings.
